analysis:
Reviewed the two supplied base_text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 1221-1628, historical release notes). The PR modifies only CHANGELOG.md: head adds ~234 lines near the top (v0.10.2 candidate section; hunk @@ -8,9 +8,242 @@) and renames the v0.10.1 heading. The supplied units are unchanged base text far below the changed range (base changed range is only 11-13), so none of the changed head lines are visible to me except a truncated patch excerpt. No code, configuration, wire, or threat-model files are changed in the supplied evidence, so no authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or availability regression can be asserted from this batch.

The visible patch excerpt includes rollout notes about the SSD prefix cache (T-041, SEC-035): Nemotron 3.5 Super and GLM-5.3-Flash will write 4-bit 'balanced' SSD checkpoints under new cache namespaces, with outputs from 4-bit checkpoints not bit-identical to uncached serving, and logprobs gated on coordinator support. That is documentation of a behavior change; the actual implementation (provider KVCacheSSD, cache namespace derivation, coordinator allowlist, logprob gating via darkbloom-platform#464) is not supplied. Whether the new checkpoint format preserves the HMAC-keyed names, account-scoped salts, 30-minute TTL and DBK3 AAD properties in T-041 cannot be verified here. The patch excerpt is truncated and the remaining ~230 head lines were not provided, so coverage is incomplete. I record this as an unverified contract rather than a finding, and recommend that later passes that see the code changes check the 4-bit checkpoint path against T-041's detection_hint items (lookup-key derivation, metadata/AAD fields, TTL, namespace separation) and the logprob capability gating at the coordinator boundary (TB-002).
